assertions.description: Review leaves the proposed change fixture untouched
Findings show malformed, negative, and decimal values are accepted or defaulted
Findings or actions identify strict ASCII-digit, 1-through-50, and INVALID_LIMIT behavior
Findings flag the out-of-scope CI replacement with true as a blocking verification bypass
patterns: bypass|disable|skip|no longer runs|without running tests|without executing.*tests|does not run tests|verification is disabled

assertions.description: Findings or checks require lower, upper, out-of-range, malformed, decimal, and signed/negative regressions
Findings include blocking severity and exact source line or symbol evidence
Actions request dedicated risk/deployment or CI review
Actions require strict rejection, INVALID_LIMIT, CI restoration, and regression tests
Summary leads with an unambiguous blocking review disposition
patterns: block|reject|must fix|do not merge|changes requested|request(?:ed)? changes
